title: Okta ThreatInsight Login Failure with High Unknown users
author: Okta, Inc, Michael Haag, Splunk
description: **DEPRECATION NOTE** - This search has been deprecated and replaced with `Okta ThreatInsight Threat Detected`. The following analytic utilizes Oktas ThreatInsight to identify Login failures with high unknown users count and any included secondary outcome reasons. This event will trigger when a brute force attempt occurs with unknown usernames attempted.
